premises.evidence_span: looking at calories and fat, it's just not enough today

premises.text: Consumers cannot understand the ingredient lists on packages
premises.evidence_span: She could barely even pronounce half the stuff in there

value.text: People know where their food comes from, how it is made, and how it affects their personal health
